The 백양누리 자료(서식) board carries a '백양누리_요금표' attachment (posted 2026.09.08) that was not machine-readable in this pass. A third-party venue-platform FAQ for the same room states 원형테이블만 보유 (banquet-only seating) and that 외부 음식/케이터링 반입 is not allowed — platform-sourced, not official.
evidence.inference: Published LED-screen pricing and a 60-120 seat band make 백양누리 a real option for a university-adjacent audience, but the base room rate is attachment-only and the banquet-only table stock conflicts with an all-day talk format; both are material, so this record is a lead rather than shortlist_ready.
